name: Flinders Emergency Student Support Grant
summary: Year-round non-repayable grant of $500 to $1,000 for domestic full-time Flinders students in short-term financial hardship.
key: The value of the grant awarded will be between $500 to $1,000.
who: Have successfully completed at least 18 units
Be enrolled full-time at Flinders University
Financial hardship or a significant deterioration in financial circumstances
how: Submit the online Student Support Grant form with supporting documents
Centrelink recipients provide a 30-day Income Statement; others provide a statement and 60 days of bank statements
catches: Processed monthly until funds run out
Part-time students with extenuating circumstances considered case by case
